mapper.select:
SELECT p.product_id, p.brand , b.brand_name, CONCAT(b.brand_name, ' ', p.model) as name, p.price, p.original_price as originalPrice, pc.category_name, p.`condition`, p.seller_id, u.nickname as sellerName, -- 押金：原价的10% (p.original_price * 0.1) as deposit, -- 起租天数：从数据库获取实际值 p.min_rental_days as minRentalDays FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_category pc ON p.category_id = pc.category_id LEFT JOIN brand b ON p.brand= b.brand_id LEFT JOIN user u ON p.seller_id = u.user_id WHERE 1=1 AND p.audit_status = 1 -- 审核通过 AND p.is_on_shelf = 1 -- 已上架
AND p.product_type = #{productType}
AND p.price BETWEEN 0 AND 50
AND p.price BETWEEN 50 AND 100
AND p.price BETWEEN 100 AND 200
AND p.price > 200
AND pc.category_code IN
#{code}
AND p.brand = #{brand}
AND pc.category_code = #{type}
AND (b.brand_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.model LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND p.product_type = 1
AND p.product_type = 2
AND p.`condition` = #{condition}
ORDER BY p.price ASC
ORDER BY p.price DESC
ORDER BY RAND() -- 随机排序

SELECT product_id, category_id, brand, model, product_type, `condition`, original_price, price, stock, seller_id, audit_status, reject_reason, is_on_shelf, create_time, update_time FROM product WHERE product_id = #{id}

SELECT p.product_id AS id, p.model AS name, b.brand_name AS brandName, p.category_id AS categoryId, p.price, p.original_price AS originalPrice, p.stock, p.min_rental_days AS minRentalDays, si.storage_path AS imageUrl, pd.parameters AS specifications, pd.img_urls AS imageUrls, pd.description AS description, sh.description AS secondHandDescription,
sh.quality_report AS qualityReport, sh.used_time AS usedTime, sh.defect_desc AS defectDesc, sh.defect_img AS defectImg, sh.seller_type AS sellerType, sh.negotiate_status AS negotiateStatus, sh.final_price AS finalPrice, p.`condition`, p.seller_id AS sellerId, u.nickname AS sellerName,
sh.parameters AS parameters, sh.warranty_info AS warrantyInfo, sh.img_urls AS secondHandImgUrls FROM product p LEFT JOIN brand b ON p.brand = b.brand_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_id, MAX(image_id) as image_id FROM product_image WHERE image_type = 'main' GROUP BY product_id ) pi ON p.product_id = pi.product_id LEFT JOIN sys_image si ON pi.image_id = si.id LEFT JOIN product_detail pd ON p.product_id = pd.product_id LEFT JOIN second_hand sh ON p.product_id = sh.product_id LEFT JOIN user u ON p.seller_id = u.user_id WHERE p.product_id = #{productId} LIMIT 1

SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.model AS name, b.brand_name AS brandName, p.price, si.storage_path AS imageUrl FROM product p LEFT JOIN brand b ON p.brand = b.brand_id LEFT JOIN product_image pi ON p.product_id = pi.product_id AND pi.image_type = 'main' LEFT JOIN sys_image si ON pi.image_id = si.id WHERE p.product_id != #{productId} -- 排除当前商品 AND p.audit_status = 1 -- 审核通过 AND p.is_on_shelf = 1 -- 已上架 AND p.product_type = #{productType} -- 只返回相同类型的商品 ORDER BY RAND() -- 随机推荐 LIMIT #{limit} -- 限制返回数量
SELECT si.storage_path FROM product_image pi LEFT JOIN sys_image si ON pi.image_id = si.id WHERE pi.product_id = #{productId} AND pi.image_type = 'main' LIMIT 1
SELECT pd.parameters FROM product_detail pd WHERE pd.product_id = #{productId} LIMIT 1
SELECT b.brand_name FROM product p LEFT JOIN brand b ON p.brand = b.brand_id WHERE p.product_id = #{productId} LIMIT 1

SELECT p.product_id AS id, p.product_id AS productId, CONCAT(b.brand_name, ' ', p.model) AS productName, p.product_type AS productType, 0 AS skuId, '颜色' AS skuAttribute, '黑色' AS skuValue, p.stock AS currentStock, p.min_stock AS minStock, 0 AS sales, p.create_time AS createTime, p.update_time AS lastUpdateTime, b.brand_name AS brandName, p.price, p.original_price AS originalPrice FROM product p LEFT JOIN brand b ON p.brand = b.brand_id WHERE 1=1
AND p.product_type = 1
AND p.product_type = 2
AND p.product_type = 3
AND p.stock <= 0
AND p.stock > 0 AND p.stock < p.min_stock
AND p.stock >= p.min_stock
AND (b.brand_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.model LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM product p LEFT JOIN brand b ON p.brand = b.brand_id WHERE 1=1
AND p.product_type = 1
AND p.product_type = 2
AND p.product_type = 3
AND p.stock <= 0
AND p.stock > 0 AND p.stock < p.min_stock
AND p.stock >= p.min_stock
AND (b.brand_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.model LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

SELECT p.product_id AS id, p.product_id AS productId, CONCAT(b.brand_name, ' ', p.model) AS productName, p.product_type AS productType, 0 AS skuId, '颜色' AS skuAttribute, '黑色' AS skuValue, p.stock AS currentStock, p.min_stock AS minStock, 0 AS sales, p.create_time AS createTime, p.update_time AS lastUpdateTime, b.brand_name AS brandName, p.price, p.original_price AS originalPrice FROM product p LEFT JOIN brand b ON p.brand = b.brand_id WHERE p.product_id = #{productId}

SELECT 1 AS id, NOW() AS changeTime, '增加' AS changeType, 0 AS beforeStock, p.stock AS afterStock, p.stock AS changeQuantity, '初始化库存' AS reason, '系统' AS operator FROM product p WHERE p.product_id = #{productId}
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET stock = #{newStock}, update_time = NOW() WHERE product_id = #{productId}
UPDATE product SET min_stock = #{minStock}, update_time = NOW() WHERE product_id = #{productId}
